items.title: CSX Stock And Rail Peers Facing A New Intermodal Volume Test
items.summary: Tariffs, shipping snarls, and costly fuel are reshaping how goods move across North America, and rail and intermodal transport stocks sit right in that crossfire. That mix of risk and rerouted trade flows can punish the unprepared investor and reward those who spot where volume and capital spending may cluster next.
